properties.description: Local values of the node's registered properties (name -> text), including the item-level visible / purpose / active; present since the property system's D23, absent in older files whose flags list visible / shadow_cast / lightmapped

prim_class.description: The erhe prim class of a node whose class carries no transform; a node without the field is an Xform

prim_type_name.description: The USD typeName token a Typed prim carries; empty for a typeless def

mesh_properties.description: Local values of the mesh attachment's registered properties (name -> text)
